release.name: hyperframes
release.source: npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.6 (--help top-level list, per-command --help for render/check/docs, and single-command probes for hidden commands figma, media-use, play, usage, events)

meta.method: Every released top-level command and hidden command probed live resolves to one inventory row (present or named exception). Render formats, docs topics are diffed from live help text. Every present row carries a mechanical probe against the built binary or the crate sources. The checker (n27-parity-check.sh) re-runs all probes and the discovery diff; anything unlisted fails naming the feature. Second-binary package surfaces (e.g. hyperframes-localize-fonts) and npm catalog counts are out of scope: only CLI, compositions, and docs at that version are inventoried.
meta.counts_explanation: Verdict reads 100% when every row is present-with-green-probes or exception-with-justification and discovery diffs are clean.

rows.hf_form: Scaffold a new composition project
Install a block or component (name or tag) into the project
rows.note: Blocks/components install by name or tag with vars baking and force, same contract as HF add.

rows.hf_form: Capture a website into components (screenshots, HTML, tokens, images, video-download mode)
rows.justification: Needs a browser page to capture into components; Framesmith has no browser (native KDL pipeline). No capture verb ships.

rows.hf_form: Browse and install registry blocks/components (words, type, tag, on-device meaning search)
rows.note: Word search, type/tag filters, and consent-gated meaning search all ship; the human picker is the numbered listing.

rows.hf_form: Start Studio for previewing compositions
rows.note: Serves the Studio review page; daemon verbs preview-status/stop/list/stop-all.

rows.hf_form: Presenter mode with audience sync
rows.note: Slideshow presenter and audience serves ship from the preview crate.

rows.hf_form: Upload a project to a stable hosted URL
rows.justification: Hosted upload and stable-URL sharing are cloud hosting (PROPOSAL Section 2 excluded). No publish verb ships.

rows.hf_form: Render a composition to video
rows.note: Core render with bootstrap, staged publish, and the full flag set covered by render-* rows.

rows.hf_form: Open a project in the HyperFrames desktop app
rows.justification: Launches the closed-source desktop app, which Framesmith does not ship; projects open via preview/play/present instead.

rows.hf_form: What changed in the desktop app since last look
rows.note: Same observable content: the project's recorded changes, readable as the shared human/agent history.

rows.hf_form: Static validation with grouped rules
Lint + runtime + layout gate
rows.note: The single gate; validate/inspect are upstream-deprecated aliases of it.

rows.hf_form: Runtime-validate in headless Chrome (upstream help marks it deprecated, use check)
rows.note: Deprecated upstream; check covers lint, runtime, layout, contrast, and audio findings.

rows.hf_form: Layout inspection with motion assertions (upstream help marks it deprecated, use check)
rows.note: Deprecated upstream; check covers overflow/occlusion/motion assertions.

rows.hf_form: Beat grid from a music track
rows.note: Pure-Rust signal analysis, no signal from the browser.

rows.hf_form: Film-time audio measurement (onsets, hits, loudness, silence, envelope, describe)
rows.justification: Framesmith waveform reports per-bucket peaks only; film-time onset/loudness/silence measurement is not shipped (loudness exists only inside the render mix).

rows.hf_form: Keyframe and motion-path diagnostics
rows.note: Computed per-frame motion values per clip and property.

rows.hf_form: PNG frames at times/angles
rows.note: Stills named by time; no MP4 is written.

rows.hf_form: Discover, apply, or clear media grading patches from the CLI
rows.justification: No CLI patch/analyze/clear verb ships; grades are authored in KDL grade elements and viewed via grade-compare/grade-bake only.

rows.hf_form: Match one clip's loudness to an LUFS target or a reference clip
rows.framesmith_form: audio normalize="loud" on the clip (integrated loudness at -16 LUFS with true-peak guarding)
rows.note: In-composition normalization at the same -16 LUFS default; there is no separate normalize-audio command.

rows.hf_form: Labeled comparison PNG of candidate grades
rows.note: Splits one composition into ungraded and graded halves.

rows.hf_form: Side-by-side comparison sheet of variants
rows.note: Joins two renders side by side with an SSIM score.

rows.hf_form: Score a render or project against the original video frame by frame (SSIM, segments, side-by-side)
rows.justification: No rebuild-vs-original scoring ships; verify judges a candidate against a single-pass oracle and compare joins two renders, neither scores against an original video.

rows.hf_form: Video-rebuild measurement suite (probe, cuts, events, frames, extract, curve, energy, ink, look, face, sync)
rows.justification: No measurement suite ships; waveform, snapshot, and keyframes cover peaks, frames, and computed motion only.

rows.hf_form: Open a reverse-any-video run, noted with HeyGen
rows.justification: Noting a run with HeyGen needs sign-in and hosted generation (cloud/account, excluded). No reverse verb ships.

rows.hf_form: Open plans or credits page
rows.justification: Account billing surface; Framesmith needs no account and has no billing surface.

rows.hf_form: Print project metadata
rows.note: Canvas, duration, and clip counts.

rows.hf_form: List all compositions in a project
rows.note: Every composition name plus the root.

rows.hf_form: Print tracks and clips; edit verbs move/trim/split/delete/set/duplicate/ids/apply/undo
rows.note: Same edit verbs plus plan/apply/undo receipts.

rows.hf_form: List, undo and restore recorded changes (shared human/agent history)
rows.note: Guarded multi-writer history with --who/--exclusive/--if-open.

rows.hf_form: Inline documentation topics in the terminal
rows.justification: No docs command ships; framesmith errors explains every error code, but the nine-topic docs surface is absent.

rows.hf_form: Render with preset fps/quality/worker configs and compare speed and size
rows.note: Times bundled references (machine-specific).

rows.hf_form: Manage the Chrome browser used for rendering (ensure/path/clear)
rows.justification: Manages a Chrome download Framesmith never has; the native pipeline needs no browser to manage.

rows.hf_form: Check system dependencies and environment
rows.note: Environment and project health facts; no browser to check.

rows.hf_form: Find and remove what the tool left on disk
rows.justification: No clean verb ships; the footage cache is project-local under logs/, bounded, and env-relocatable, so removal is deleting that directory.

rows.hf_form: Check for updates and show upgrade instructions
rows.justification: No upgrade verb ships in this tree; version reporting exists via --version and the update check lands with T002.
rows.note: upgrade verb ships (update check + update apply, consent-gated); verified by cli_n27_version_update suite.

rows.hf_form: Render compositions on hosted cloud
rows.justification: Hosted cloud rendering is excluded (PROPOSAL Section 2). No cloud verb ships.

rows.hf_form: Deploy and drive distributed renders on AWS Lambda
rows.justification: Self-hosted cloud rendering is excluded (PROPOSAL Section 2). No lambda verb ships.

rows.hf_form: Deploy and drive distributed renders on Google Cloud Run
rows.justification: Self-hosted cloud rendering is excluded (PROPOSAL Section 2). No cloudrun verb ships.

rows.hf_form: Install, check, and update skills for AI coding tools
rows.note: Hashed-manifest install/check/update over skill locations.

rows.hf_form: Transcribe to word-level timestamps or import a transcript
rows.note: Engine/model/language flags ship.

rows.hf_form: List or download on-device models
rows.note: Consent-gated installs.

rows.hf_form: Generate speech audio from text with a local model
rows.note: Voice/speed/language/model flags ship.

rows.hf_form: Remove background, producing transparent media and a background plate
rows.note: Emits subject alpha plus the background plate.

rows.hf_form: Sign in and manage credentials
rows.justification: Sign-in and credential management are account surface (excluded); Framesmith needs no account.

rows.hf_form: Submit rating, comment, or search-miss report
rows.justification: Remote feedback intake needs an account service; local-first Framesmith ships no feedback verb (search misses go to catalog report-miss).

rows.hf_form: Manage usage telemetry
rows.justification: Telemetry collection is not shipped (local-first; privacy per specification Section 11). No telemetry verb ships.

rows.hf_form: Import Figma assets, tokens, and components (hidden command)
rows.justification: Figma REST import is not shipped; Framesmith imports local design files through the catalog and design-import skill instead.

rows.hf_form: Resolve project media through a provider cascade (hidden command)
rows.justification: No hosted provider cascade ships; Framesmith adopts local media and catalog items, never a provider resolver.

rows.hf_form: Play a composition in a lightweight player (hidden command)
rows.note: Lightweight player serve from the preview crate.

rows.hf_form: Read remaining harness subscription usage (hidden command)
rows.justification: Account usage meter; no account exists to meter.

rows.hf_form: Emit a skill-usage telemetry event (hidden command)
rows.justification: Emits telemetry events for a pipeline that does not exist (local-first). No events verb ships.

rows.hf_form: H.264 MP4 with AAC, faststart
VP9 WebM with alpha, Opus audio
MOV (H.264 or ProRes 4444 with alpha)
rows.note: ProRes profiles ship; the mov row covers both.

rows.hf_form: Looping GIF
rows.framesmith_form: --format gif (palette-fixed, deterministic, loop count on the job)
rows.note: Loop count rides the render job (0 means forever).

rows.hf_form: RGBA PNG frame sequence directory
rows.note: Spelling differs (pngseq); the directory output is the same.

rows.hf_form: HLS VOD playlist with segments (SDR only, no GPU)
Render one span of the film as its own MP4
--hdr/--sdr, PQ and HLG auto-detection, tone mapping when the format cannot carry HDR
rows.framesmith_form: --hdr off|pq|hlg|auto with Main10/HEVC params and tone mapping for SDR formats

rows.hf_form: draft, looks (default), delivery, standard/high plus --crf/--video-bitrate
rows.note: Preset names differ by design; looks/delivery aliases are not shipped.

rows.hf_form: --keyframe-interval, --max-bitrate, --buffer-size
rows.note: No separate --buffer-size knob; it derives from --maxrate.

rows.hf_form: Hardware encoding (VideoToolbox, NVENC, VAAPI, QSV, AMF)
720p/1080p/4K presets with integer supersampling
rows.note: Orientation presets are expressed as explicit dimensions instead.

rows.hf_form: --variables/--variables-file, --batch rows, --batch-concurrency, --batch-fail-fast, --strict-variables
rows.note: --batch-concurrency is spelled --jobs; the file-row contract is the same.

rows.hf_form: --workers, segmented capture, --resume/--keep-segments, --max-concurrent-renders, --low-memory-mode, --frames-cache-dir
rows.note: Browser-per-worker capture is replaced by chunked local/LAN orchestration; ledger is the chunk journal.

rows.hf_form: Fail on lint errors, or errors and warnings
Warn-only render on unready media instead of failing
rows.justification: No warn-only mode ships; render refuses on unusable input and writes no MP4 (proven by the n25 gate refusal check).

rows.hf_form: Deterministic render inside a pinned container image
rows.justification: No container image ships; determinism is native single-pass bytes, not a container pin.

rows.hf_form: --browser-timeout, --protocol-timeout, --player-ready-timeout
rows.justification: Timeouts for browser navigation, CDP protocol, and player readiness; Framesmith has no browser to time out.

rows.hf_form: libvpx-vp9 speed knob for WebM encodes
rows.justification: No vp9 speed knob ships; WebM encodes with the encoder default, chosen only through --encoder.

rows.hf_form: Text clips with font, size, spacing, line height, alignment, case
Boxes, SVG, paths with fill, border, radius
rows.framesmith_form: box, flex, path, svg clips (border-width, border-radius, border-color)
rows.note: KDL style attrs are CSS-hyphenated (border-width, border-color).

rows.hf_form: Flex containers and layout
PNG/JPEG images, decode, place, fit, position, color tags
rows.framesmith_form: image clip (fit, position, trim, rate; HEIC converted at compile)

rows.hf_form: Video decode, place, fit, trim, rate, loop
Audio with volume, fades, trim, rate
Bar, line, area, pie, scatter, gauge, radar data viz
rows.framesmith_form: chart clip (bar, line, area, pie, donut, scatter, radar, gauge)
rows.note: Native chart clip replaces the D3 readiness adapter.

rows.hf_form: Lottie animation elements
Sub-compositions, mounted timelines
Leaflet/Mapbox/MapLibre/Google Maps readiness
rows.note: Native map clip replaces the readiness adapters.

rows.hf_form: 3D scenes, cameras, lights
rows.note: Native 3D scene replaces the Three.js adapter.

rows.hf_form: One caption track, word timing, overrides, 13/7/11 animation presets, behind-subject
rows.framesmith_form: captions clip (srt/vtt/transcript inline cues, word overrides, 13/7/11 families)

rows.hf_form: Tweens, keyframes, easing, stagger, repeat
rows.framesmith_form: tween/key/set directives with ease, stagger, repeat
rows.note: Native motion replaces GSAP.

rows.hf_form: Declared variables, binding, per-host overrides, strict validation
rows.framesmith_form: variable declarations plus CLI --variables/--batch and SDK variable APIs

rows.hf_form: Named themes with tokens (bold, editorial, neutral)
rows.note: Themes are authored per composition instead of three shipped presets.

rows.hf_form: Deck manifest with notes, fragments, branches, hotspots, autoplay
Preset looks, adjust, wheels, curves, HSL, vignette/grain, LUTs, groups, bake to .cube
rows.framesmith_form: grade (preset, wheels, curves, HSL, vignette, grain, LUT) plus lane groups plus grade-bake
rows.note: Preset names differ by design; LUT import and .cube baking ship.

rows.hf_form: 16-effect ordered chain (EQ, dynamics, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, pitchshift), truepeak limiter, 22 presets, EQ jobs, levers, groups, master chain
rows.justification: Only delay and reverb sound effects ship; EQ, compressors/limiters, presets, groups and the master chain are absent.

rows.hf_form: Lanes for volume, rate, effect params, and presets (512 points per lane)
rows.justification: Volume envelopes via key/tween/set ship; rate and effect-parameter lanes are absent.

rows.hf_form: Music ducks under voice, strength 0-1
rows.framesmith_form: duck-under plus duck-amount on audio and video clips
rows.note: Deterministic level rule, no signal detection.

rows.hf_form: Blur, Pixelate, Bloom, glitch, print, ASCII/engraving art families
rows.justification: Both catalogs hold 18 presets with different coverage; HF retro/glitch/print projects (scanlines, CRT, halftone, ASCII, ...) have no equivalent.

rows.hf_form: Five kernels: fractal noise, wave warp, displacement map, luma matte, noise
rows.framesmith_form: vfx chain with the same five kernels

rows.hf_form: GLSL shader transitions (domain-warp, whip-pan, sdf-iris, ...)
rows.framesmith_form: CPU transition kinds (fade, dissolve, wipes, push, cover, ...)
rows.justification: No GLSL/page compositor ships; the 14 shader transitions are absent and only crossfade-class transitions cover the user-visible gap.

rows.hf_form: Sub-frame accumulation (samples, shutter angle, blend), capture/filter tiers
rows.note: Same user controls; both tiers are native draw passes.

rows.hf_form: Rate lanes with log interpolation, 9 presets, freeze frame
rows.justification: Static playback rate ships; log-interpolated rate lanes, the 9 presets, and freeze are absent.

rows.hf_form: 18 bundled families with alias map; project fonts embedded
rows.framesmith_form: project font declarations embedded deterministically (glyph/layout crates honor font-family try-order)
rows.note: System-font discovery plus project fonts replace the fixed 18-family bundle.

rows.hf_form: Browser animation runtimes driving the timeline
rows.justification: Need a browser to run GSAP, CSS animations, or WAAPI; Framesmith animates with native tween/set/key instead.

rows.hf_form: WebGPU compositions with device creation before capture
rows.justification: Needs a WebGPU runtime and browser capture; Framesmith draws natively and has no WebGPU device or sandboxed runtime.

rows.hf_form: registerFrameSource (ready, render at time, dispose, source range)
rows.framesmith_form: custom sources in the render pipeline plus the SDK frame surface

rows.hf_form: drawElementImage browser capture API
rows.justification: Browser capture API; Framesmith has no browser to rasterize HTML from.

rows.hf_form: Sandboxed external HTML films bridge
rows.justification: Bridges sandboxed iframe films through a browser; out of scope for the native pipeline.

rows.hf_form: 11-panel editor with timeline, canvas, inspector, panels, hot reload
rows.framesmith_form: preview serve with studio modules (transport, canvas, inspector, clips, audio, renders, variables)
rows.note: Studio ships as the preview serve; daemon verbs manage it.

rows.hf_form: @hyperframes/player (play/pause/seek, events, controls)
@hyperframes/sdk open composition, edit ops, patches, history coalescing
rows.framesmith_form: sdk crate (open with persist/preview/overrides/history/coalesce, edits, history, variables)
rows.note: Crate API, not a CLI command.

rows.hf_form: 456 items: 210 blocks, 238 components, 8 examples; shelves, tags, variables
rows.framesmith_form: bundled clean-room catalog (own blocks/components, shelves, install gating)
rows.note: Items are never copied from HyperFrames (clean room); the equivalent catalog is our own.

rows.hf_form: 21 skills (router, 10 creation workflows, domain skills) as an agent plugin
rows.framesmith_form: 20 skills (router, 10 creation workflows incl. migration, domain skills) plus route command
rows.note: Own clean-room skills; counts differ by design, workflow coverage is the parity claim.

rows.hf_form: llms.txt, prompting guides, WebMCP studio_* tools, inspector HTTP
rows.justification: No docs/agent-protocol surface ships (no llms.txt, no WebMCP tools); agents drive the CLI, SDK, and preview server instead.

rows.hf_form: 15 coordinated package dirs (CLI, player, sdk, studio-server, lambda, ...)
rows.framesmith_form: Rust crates plus one binary (distribution is T001)
rows.justification: No npm packages ship; the crate workspace and single binary are the distribution.

rows.hf_form: Element map, live inspection, timeline queries
rows.framesmith_form: timeline, info, keyframes queries plus the preview Studio inspection
rows.note: Capability parity, not package parity.

rows.hf_form: Top-level help and version reporting
0 success, 1 run failed, 2 bad command line or refusal
rows.note: Measured: unknown subcommand exits 2, check on a missing folder exits 1, check on a valid folder exits 0.

rows.hf_form: --json on most commands with an error envelope on failure
rows.framesmith_form: --json on check, lint, snapshot, keyframes, compare, and listing verbs

rows.hf_form: .env autoload, HYPERFRAMES_* variables, daily skills notice, 60s silence diagnostic, HYPERFRAMES_AGENT
rows.justification: HF-specific env vars and background notices do not ship; Framesmith honors FRAMESMITH_* configuration only.

rows.hf_form: Inline docs: data-attributes, examples, rendering, gsap, troubleshooting, compositions, audio, transcribe, motion-blur
rows.justification: No docs command ships; framesmith errors documents every error code, but the nine-topic docs surface is absent.
